channel.title: Udemy incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Udemy's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Resolved – SSO Login Disruption [resolved]
item.description: The recent release causing SSO login issues has been rolled back, and login functionality has returned to normal. This incident is now resolved. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.title: Investigating Web Login Application Errors [resolved]
item.description:
Our engineering team has resolved the issue affecting logged-in learners on Udemy.com. Users were experiencing application errors on the homepage and My Learning page when accessing the site via desktop web browsers.
A fix has been fully deployed and the issue is no longer occurring. No action is required on your end.
We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

item.title: SSO Login failures [resolved]
item.description: Resolved – SSO Login Issues August 5, 2026 | 06:53 UTC – 08:44 UTC We have resolved an issue that affected SSO-based login for some Udemy Business users. During this window, a subset of users experienced login failures when attempting to authenticate via SSO. The issue was caused by a degradation in a third-party identity service and has been fully resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience and are taking steps to improve our detection and response for similar third-party disruptions in the future.

We have resolved the issue with the Course completion feature on our site, but some users who watched the full course content during the incident may still see the lectures not being marked as completed. We appreciate your patience.
[Action needed] Udemy is working to fix this issue automatically as part of the cleanup tasks from this incident, but it may take more time. If you urgently need this to be resolved, please contact support who can support you further.

This incident did not impact Udemy Business users.

We will continue to monitor to ensure everything remains stable.

item.title: Instructor Announcement Metrics – Partial Data Delay [resolved]
item.description:
Resolved – Instructor Announcement Metrics – Partial Data Delay
Start time: October 20, 2025 Resolved: November 7, 2025, 16:31 UTC
We’ve resolved the issue that caused some instructor announcement metrics to show incomplete or zero delivery data between October 20 and November 6.
All affected data has now been restored, and announcement delivery and analytics are updating normally.
During this period, announcements were successfully delivered to learners, but instructors saw missing or incorrect delivery counts in their dashboards. This visual issue has now been corrected.
We appreciate your patience while our teams worked to restore accurate metrics.

item.title: Critical component on our site is degraded [resolved]
item.description:
Status: Resolved
We have resolved the stability issues affecting the login feature on our site. Performance is back to normal.
This issue impacted both Udemy Business and Udemy.com users attempting to log in with passwordless code authentication, resulting in “403 Forbidden” errors.
We appreciate your patience while our engineering team worked to restore normal functionality.
